title: Deferred features are rejected with generic or wrong diagnostics, not structured unsupported diagnostics
The prototype has no std.num traits, still rejects floating %, and its @num_suffix shape check requires a primitive parameter type
The prototype parser has no compound assignment, and its lexer lacks the new compound assignment tokens
Embedding simplification cannot be fully exercised: the prototype compiles one module without trait imports, so trait availability is untested, and the fixtures need package roles
Visibility-aware member lookup cannot be exercised: the prototype compiles one module, so every own member is visible, and the fixtures need package roles
The prototype's std.ops declares no Index or IndexSet, and indexing is built in for List and Map only
The prototype parser rejects an associated type binding in a supertrait list
The prototype's std declares no operator traits, so primitives implement none and generic operator bounds fail
Trait-argument ownership fixtures need the `Iterable` trait or package roles, which the prototype lacks
Entry-point cases use a private declaration in `pub fn main`, so they also report `private-type-leak`
The prototype's std.ops declares no operator traits, so operators on user types are rejected
The bitwise and shift operator traits are missing, and `**` on a data operand reports mixed-numeric-types
Typed derivation M29's per-trait Self-line warning needs a second package, and the prototype CLI has no package roles
The `disposed-file` runtime profile named in spec/conformance/README.md does not exist
The prototype has no pack operations, so `pack.map(` on a local named `pack` resolves as a method call
A script's top-level println needs the inferred script entry requirement row, which the prototype does not infer
A spread of function lists does not take the union row: the prototype checks a spread literal as a list of lists
A function whose result is a function type with a row fails Wasm validation: the signature type string reads the inner row as the outer function's, so a closure result with the union row cannot run
The left-literal fixture cannot reach its type-mismatch: the prototype has no Mul trait to implement
Hand-written newtype operators need the std.ops operator traits, which the prototype lacks
